# Foo

[Foo](https://example.com/foo), the best library for a < b checks in every browser you care about today.

It has been in production for years, across many sites, and it keeps working as browsers change around it. Teams adopt it for its small size and steady release schedule, and they stay for the care taken over each edge case that real pages throw at it.

Its documentation covers installation, configuration and the common recipes. A short guide walks through the first check, and a longer reference lists every option along with the behaviour it controls and the version that introduced it.
